verses.kjv: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.modern: The word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri, during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and during the reign of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.

verses.kjv: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the LORD.
verses.modern: This was the beginning of the LORD's message through Hosea. The LORD said to Him, "Go, take a wife of whoredoms and have children of whoredoms, for the land has committed great whoredom in departing from the LORD."

verses.kjv: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
verses.modern: So He went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore Him a son.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Him, "Name Him Jezreel, because I will soon punish the house of Jehu for the massacre at Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.modern: In that day I will break Israel's bow in the Valley of Jezreel."

verses.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
verses.modern: Gomer conceived again and gave birth to a daughter. The LORD said to Hosea, "Name her Lo-ruhamah — for I will no longer show mercy to Israel or forgive them.

verses.kjv: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
verses.modern: But I will show mercy to Judah, and I will save them — not by bow or sword or battle, not by horses or horsemen, but by the LORD their God."

verses.kjv: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
verses.modern: After Gomer had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived again and gave birth to a son.

verses.kjv: Then said God, Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.
verses.modern: The LORD said, "Name Him Lo-ammi — for You are not My people, and I am not Your God."

verses.kjv: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.
verses.modern: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. In the very place where it was said to them, "You are not My people," they will be called "sons of the living God."

verses.kjv: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
verses.modern: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will come together and appoint one leader. They will come up out of the land, for great will be the day of Jezreel.

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Hosea to marry a wife of whoredoms as a picture of Israel's unfaithfulness. Gomer bears three children: Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah ("no mercy"), and Lo-ammi ("not My people"). Yet the LORD promises that in the very place where Israel was rejected, they will be called sons of the living God.

verses.kjv: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
verses.modern: Say to Your brothers, "My people," and to Your sisters, "My beloved."

verses.kjv: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.modern: Plead with Your mother — plead with her! For she is not My wife, and I am not her husband. Let her put away her whoredoms and her adulteries from between her breasts,

verses.kjv: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
verses.modern: or I will strip her naked and expose her as on the day she was born. I will make her like a desert, turn her into a parched land, and let her die of thirst.

verses.kjv: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
verses.modern: I will not show mercy to her children, because they are the children of whoredoms.

verses.kjv: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
verses.modern: Their mother has played the harlot and done shamefully. She said, "I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink."

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
verses.modern: Therefore I will block her path with thornbushes. I will wall her in so that she cannot find her way.

verses.kjv: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
verses.modern: She will chase after her lovers but not catch them. She will look for them but not find them. Then she will say, "I will go back to my first husband, for I was better off then than now."

verses.kjv: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
verses.modern: She did not know that I was the one giving her the grain, the new wine, and the olive oil — and that I lavished silver and gold on her, which they used for Baal.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
verses.modern: Therefore I will take back My grain when it ripens and My new wine when it is ready. I will take away My wool and My linen, which I gave her to cover her nakedness.

verses.kjv: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
verses.modern: So I will expose her shame before the eyes of her lovers, and no one will take her out of My hands.

verses.kjv: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
verses.modern: I will stop all her celebrations — her yearly festivals, her New Moons, her Sabbath days, all her appointed feasts.

verses.kjv: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
verses.modern: I will ruin her vines and her fig trees, which she said were payment from her lovers. I will turn them into a thicket, and wild animals will devour them.

verses.kjv: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will punish her for the days she burned incense to the Baals, when she adorned herself with rings and jewelry and went after her lovers — and forgot Me, declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
verses.modern: Therefore I am now going to draw her away and lead her into the desert, and speak tenderly to her.

verses.kjv: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: There I will give her back her vineyards and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. She will sing there as in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
verses.modern: "In that day," declares the LORD, "you will call Me 'my husband.' You will no longer call Me 'my master.'

verses.kjv: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
verses.modern: I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips; no longer will their names be invoked.

verses.kjv: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
verses.modern: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky, and the creatures that move along the ground. I will abolish the bow and sword and battle from the land, so that all may rest in safety.

verses.kjv: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
verses.modern: I will betroth You to Me forever. I will betroth You in righteousness and justice, in love and mercy.

verses.kjv: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
verses.modern: I will betroth You in faithfulness, and You will know the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
verses.modern: In that day I will respond," declares the LORD — "I will respond to the skies, and they will respond to the earth;

verses.kjv: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
verses.modern: the earth will respond to the grain, the new wine, and the olive oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.

verses.kjv: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
verses.modern: I will plant her for Myself in the land. I will show mercy to the one I called 'Not My people.' I will say to those called 'Not My people,' 'You are My people,' and they will say, 'You are my God.' "

chapters.summary: The LORD charges unfaithful Israel like a husband charges his adulterous wife. She chased after her lovers and did not know that the LORD gave her the grain, wine, and oil. He will hedge up her way with thorns until she says, "I will go back to my first husband." Then the LORD will allure her, speak tenderly to her, and betroth her to Himself forever.

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Go, show Your love to Your wife again, though she is loved by another man and is an adulteress. Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes."

verses.kjv: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
verses.modern: So I bought her for fifteen pieces of silver and about a homer and a half of barley.

verses.kjv: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
verses.modern: Then I told her, "You are to live with me many days; You must not play the harlot or be with any other man, and I will also be for You."

verses.kjv: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
verses.modern: For the Israelites will live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred stone, without ephod or household gods.

verses.kjv: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.
verses.modern: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the LORD and to His goodness in the last days.

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Hosea to love his adulterous wife again and buy her back — a picture of how the LORD loves Israel despite her unfaithfulness. She is to remain faithful for many days, for Israel will abide many days without a king, without a prince, and without a sacrifice. Afterward they will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king.

verses.kjv: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.modern: Hear the word of the LORD, You Israelites! The LORD has a charge to bring against You who live in the land: there is no faithfulness, no mercy, no knowledge of God in the land.

verses.kjv: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.modern: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and adultery. Violence breaks out, and bloodshed follows bloodshed.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.modern: Because of this the land dries up, and all who live in it waste away. The beasts of the field, the birds in the sky, and the fish in the sea are swept away.

verses.kjv: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.modern: But let no one bring a charge; let no one accuse another. Your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

verses.kjv: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.modern: You stumble day and night, and the prophets stumble with You. So I will destroy Your mother —

verses.kjv: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
verses.modern: my people are destroyed from lack of knowledge. Because You have rejected knowledge, I also reject You as My priests. Because You have ignored the law of Your God, I also will ignore Your children.

verses.kjv: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
verses.modern: The more priests there were, the more they sinned against Me; they exchanged their glory for something shameful.

verses.kjv: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.modern: They feed on the sins of My people and relish their iniquity.

verses.kjv: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
verses.modern: And it will be: like people, like priests. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.

verses.kjv: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
verses.modern: They will eat but not have enough; they will commit whoredom but not increase, because they have left off to take heed to the LORD to give themselves

verses.kjv: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.modern: to whoredom. Old wine and new wine take away the heart of My people.

verses.kjv: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
verses.modern: They consult a wooden idol and are answered by a stick of wood. A spirit of whoredoms has caused them to err; they have gone a whoring from under their God.

verses.kjv: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
verses.modern: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn incense on the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shade is good. Therefore Your daughters shall commit whoredom, and Your spouses shall commit adultery.

verses.kjv: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
verses.modern: I will not punish Your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor Your spouses when they commit adultery, because the men themselves are separated with whores and sacrifice with harlots. A people without understanding will come to ruin!

verses.kjv: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
verses.modern: Even if You, Israel, commit adultery, do not let Judah become guilty. Do not go to Gilgal; do not go up to Beth Aven. Do not swear, "As the LORD lives!"

verses.kjv: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.modern: Israel has slid back like a backsliding heifer. Now the LORD will feed them like a lamb in a large place.

verses.kjv: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.modern: Ephraim is joined to idols — leave Him alone!

verses.kjv: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
verses.modern: Even when their drinks are gone, they keep on committing adultery. Their rulers dearly love shameful ways.

verses.kjv: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.modern: A whirlwind will sweep them away, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.

chapters.summary: The LORD brings a charge against Israel: there is no truth, no mercy, no knowledge of God in the land. "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge." The priests feed on the people's sin, and the spirit of whoredoms has led them astray — they sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn incense under every green tree.

verses.kjv: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, O house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.modern: Hear this, You priests! Pay attention, you Israelites! Listen, you of the royal house! This judgment is against you: you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.

verses.kjv: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
verses.modern: The rebels are knee-deep in slaughter. I will discipline all of them.

verses.kjv: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
verses.modern: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me. Ephraim, You now commit whoredom; Israel is defiled.

verses.kjv: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
verses.modern: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God. The spirit of whoredoms is in their midst; they do not know the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
verses.modern: Israel's arrogance testifies against them. Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; Judah also stumbles with them.

verses.kjv: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.modern: When they go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, they will not find Him; He has withdrawn from them.

verses.kjv: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.modern: They are unfaithful to the LORD; they give birth to illegitimate children. Now their feasts will devour them and their fields.

verses.kjv: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after thee, O Benjamin.
verses.modern: Sound the trumpet in Gibeah, the horn in Ramah. Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven; lead on, Benjamin!

verses.kjv: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.modern: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of reckoning. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.

verses.kjv: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.modern: Judah's leaders are like those who move boundary stones. I will pour out My wrath on them like a flood of water.

verses.kjv: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
verses.modern: Ephraim is oppressed, trampled in judgment, intent on pursuing idols.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.modern: I am like a moth to Ephraim, like rot to the people of Judah.

verses.kjv: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.modern: When Ephraim saw His sickness, and Judah saw His sores, then Ephraim turned to Assyria, and sent to the great king for help. But He is not able to cure You, not able to heal Your sores.

verses.kjv: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
verses.modern: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a great lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces and go away; I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.

verses.kjv: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
verses.modern: Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt. And they will seek My face; in their misery they will earnestly seek Me.

chapters.summary: Judgment falls on the priests, the people, and the royal house — all have gone deep into corruption. Ephraim and Judah will stumble in their iniquity. The LORD will tear them like a lion and go away until they acknowledge their guilt and seek His face in their affliction.

verses.kjv: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.modern: "Come, let us return to the LORD. He has torn us to pieces but He will heal us; He has injured us but He will bind up our wounds.

verses.kjv: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
verses.modern: After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will restore us, that we may live in His presence.

verses.kjv: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verses.modern: Let us acknowledge the LORD; let us press on to know Him. As surely as the sun rises, He will appear; He will come to us like the winter rains, like the spring rains that water the earth."

verses.kjv: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
verses.modern: What can I do with You, Ephraim? What can I do with You, Judah? Your love is like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears.

verses.kjv: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
verses.modern: Therefore I cut You in pieces with My prophets; I killed You with the words of My mouth — then My judgments go forth like the sun.

verses.kjv: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.modern: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

verses.kjv: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.modern: As at Adam, they have transgressed the covenant; they were unfaithful to Me there.

verses.kjv: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
verses.modern: Gilead is a city of evildoers, stained with footprints of blood.

verses.kjv: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
verses.modern: As marauders lie in ambush for a man, so do bands of priests. They murder on the road to Shechem, carrying out their wicked schemes.

verses.kjv: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
verses.modern: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim; Israel is defiled.

verses.kjv: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
verses.modern: Also for you, Judah, a harvest is appointed. When I bring again the captivity of My people,

chapters.summary: Israel calls out to return to the LORD who has torn them but will heal them. Yet the LORD responds: "Your goodness is like a morning cloud, and like the early dew it goes away." He desires mercy and not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings. Ephraim and Judah have transgressed the covenant.

verses.kjv: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
verses.modern: when I would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is exposed and the crimes of Samaria revealed. They practice deceit; thieves break into houses, bandits rob in the streets.

verses.kjv: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.modern: But they do not realize that I remember all their evil deeds. Their sins engulf them; they are always before Me.

verses.kjv: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.modern: They delight the king with their wickedness, the princes with their lies.

verses.kjv: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
verses.modern: They are all adulterers, burning like an oven whose fire the baker need not stir from the kneading of the dough till it rises.

verses.kjv: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
verses.modern: On the day of the festival of our king, the princes become inflamed with wine, and he joins hands with the mockers.

verses.kjv: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
verses.modern: Their hearts are like an oven; they approach him with intrigue. Their passion smolders all night; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.

verses.kjv: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
verses.modern: All of them are hot as an oven; they devour their rulers. All their kings fall, and none of them calls on Me.

verses.kjv: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.modern: Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is a flat loaf not turned over.

verses.kjv: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
verses.modern: Foreigners sap his strength, but he does not realize it. His hair is sprinkled with gray, but he does not notice.

verses.kjv: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
verses.modern: Israel's arrogance testifies against Him, but despite all this He does not return to the LORD His God or seek Him.

verses.kjv: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.modern: Ephraim is like a dove, easily deceived and senseless — now calling to Egypt, now turning to Assyria.

verses.kjv: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
verses.modern: When they go, I will throw My net over them; I will pull them down like birds in the sky. When I hear them flocking together, I will catch them.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.modern: Woe to them, because they have fled from Me! Destruction to them, because they have rebelled against Me! I long to redeem them but they speak lies against Me.

verses.kjv: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
verses.modern: They do not cry out to Me from their hearts but wail on their beds. They slash themselves, appealing to their gods for grain and new wine, but they turn away from Me.

verses.kjv: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
verses.modern: I trained them and strengthened their arms, but they plot evil against Me.

verses.kjv: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: They do not turn to the Most High; they are like a faulty bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword because of their insolent words. For this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt.

chapters.summary: The iniquity of Ephraim and the wickedness of Samaria are exposed — they are full of deceit, theft, and drunkenness. Their kings fall one after another, and none of them call on the LORD. Ephraim is like a cake not turned — half-baked, mixing himself among the peoples, calling to Egypt and Assyria instead of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
verses.modern: Put the trumpet to Your lips! An eagle is over the house of the LORD because the people have broken My covenant and rebelled against My law.

verses.kjv: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
verses.modern: Israel cries out to Me, "O our God, we acknowledge You!"

verses.kjv: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.modern: But Israel has rejected what is good; an enemy will pursue Him.

verses.kjv: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.modern: They set up kings without My consent; they choose princes without My approval. With their silver and gold they make idols for themselves — to their own destruction.

verses.kjv: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
verses.modern: Throw out Your calf-idol, O Samaria! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?

verses.kjv: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.modern: This idol is from Israel! A craftsman has made it; it is not God. It will be broken in pieces, that calf of Samaria!

verses.kjv: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.modern: They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind. The stalk has no head; it will produce no flour. Were it to yield grain, foreigners would swallow it up.

verses.kjv: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
verses.modern: Israel is swallowed up; now she is among the nations like something no one wants.

verses.kjv: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
verses.modern: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has sold herself to lovers.

verses.kjv: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
verses.modern: Even though they have sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them together. They will begin to waste away under the oppression of the mighty king.

verses.kjv: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
verses.modern: Ephraim has built many altars for sin offerings, but these have become altars for sinning.

verses.kjv: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
verses.modern: I wrote for them the many things of My law, but they regarded them as something foreign.

verses.kjv: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
verses.modern: Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to Me, and though they eat the meat, the LORD is not pleased with them. Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.

verses.kjv: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.modern: Israel has forgotten their Maker and built palaces; Judah has fortified many towns. But I will send fire on their cities that will consume their fortresses.

chapters.summary: The trumpet sounds the alarm — an eagle hovers over the house of the LORD because Israel has broken the covenant and rebelled against the law. They set up kings without the LORD's approval and made idols of silver and gold. Israel has forgotten his Maker and built temples; they will reap the whirlwind.

verses.kjv: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
verses.modern: Do not rejoice, O Israel; do not be jubilant like the other nations. For you have gone a whoring from your God; You have loved a reward upon every cornfloor.

verses.kjv: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
verses.modern: Threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people; the new wine will fail them.

verses.kjv: They shall not dwell in the LORD's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
verses.modern: They will not remain in the LORD's land; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

verses.kjv: They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD, nor will their sacrifices please Him. Such sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat them will be unclean. This food will be for themselves; it will not come into the temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
verses.modern: What will You do on the day of Your appointed festivals, on the feast days of the LORD?

verses.kjv: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
verses.modern: Even if they escape from destruction, Egypt will gather them, and Memphis will bury them. Their treasures of silver will be taken over by nettles, and thorns will be in their tabernacles.

verses.kjv: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
verses.modern: The days of punishment are coming, the days of reckoning are at hand. Let Israel know this. Because your sins are so many and your hostility so great, the prophet is considered a fool, the inspired man a maniac.

verses.kjv: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
verses.modern: The prophet, along with my God, is the watchman over Ephraim, yet snares await Him on all His paths, and hostility in the house of His God.

verses.kjv: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.modern: They have sunk deep into corruption, as in the days of Gibeah. God will remember their iniquity; He will punish them for their sins.

verses.kjv: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
verses.modern: When I found Israel, it was like finding grapes in the desert; when I saw your fathers, it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree. But when they came to Baal Peor, they consecrated themselves to that shameful idol and became as vile as the thing they loved.

verses.kjv: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
verses.modern: Ephraim's glory will fly away like a bird — no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.

verses.kjv: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.modern: Even if they rear children, I will bereave them of every one. Woe to them when I turn away from them!

verses.kjv: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
verses.modern: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place. But Ephraim will bring out their children to the slayer.

verses.kjv: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.modern: Give them, LORD — what will You give them? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that are dry.

verses.kjv: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
verses.modern: Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal, I hated them there. Because of their sinful deeds, I will drive them out of My house. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.

verses.kjv: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.modern: Ephraim is struck down; their root is withered; they yield no fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay their cherished offspring.

verses.kjv: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.modern: My God will reject them because they have not listened to Him; they will be wanderers among the nations.

chapters.summary: Israel will not rejoice like other nations, for she has gone a whoring from her God. The days of visitation and recompense have come. The prophet is called a fool, and Ephraim is snared. Because of the greatness of their iniquity, the LORD will cast them away — they will be wanderers among the nations.

verses.kjv: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
verses.modern: Israel is an empty vine; He brings forth fruit for Himself. The more His fruit increased, the more altars He built; the better His land, the more goodly images they made.

verses.kjv: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
verses.modern: Their heart is deceitful, and now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will demolish their altars and destroy their sacred stones.

verses.kjv: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
verses.modern: Then they will say, "We have no king because we did not revere the LORD. But even if we had a king, what could He do for us?"

verses.kjv: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.modern: They make many promises, take false oaths, and make agreements; therefore lawsuits spring up like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.

verses.kjv: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.modern: The people of Samaria fear for the calf-idol of Beth Aven. Its people will mourn over it, and so will its idolatrous priests — those who had rejoiced over its splendor, because it will be taken from them into exile.

verses.kjv: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.modern: It will be carried to Assyria as tribute for the great king. Ephraim will be disgraced; Israel will be ashamed of its foreign alliances.

verses.kjv: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
verses.modern: Samaria and its king will float away like a twig on the surface of the waters.

verses.kjv: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.modern: The high places of wickedness will be destroyed — it is the sin of Israel. Thorns and thistles will grow up and cover their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, "Cover us!" and to the hills, "Fall on us!"

verses.kjv: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.modern: Since the days of Gibeah, You have sinned, O Israel, and there you have remained. Did not war overtake the evildoers in Gibeah?

verses.kjv: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
verses.modern: When I please, I will punish them; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bonds for their double sin.

verses.kjv: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.modern: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her fair neck. I will drive Ephraim, Judah must plow, and Jacob must break up the ground.

verses.kjv: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.modern: Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap the fruit of mercy, and break up Your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the LORD, until He comes and showers His righteousness on You.

verses.kjv: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.modern: But You have planted wickedness, You have reaped evil, You have eaten the fruit of deception. Because You have depended on Your own strength and on Your many warriors,

verses.kjv: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.modern: the roar of battle will rise against Your people, so that all Your fortresses will be devastated — as Shalman devastated Beth Arbel on the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to the ground with their children.

verses.kjv: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
verses.modern: So will it happen to you, Bethel, because your wickedness is great. When that day dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

chapters.summary: Israel is a luxuriant vine that bears fruit for itself — the more prosperous the land, the more altars and images they built. Their altars will be broken down and their images destroyed. The LORD calls them to sow in righteousness and reap in mercy, to break up the fallow ground — but they have plowed wickedness and will reap iniquity.

verses.kjv: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.modern: When Israel was a child, I loved Him, and out of Egypt I called My son.

verses.kjv: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.modern: But the more they were called, the more they went away from Me. They kept sacrificing to the Baals and burning incense to carved idols.

verses.kjv: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.modern: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms; but they did not realize it was I who healed them.

verses.kjv: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
verses.modern: I led them with cords of human kindness, with ties of love. I lifted the yoke from their neck and bent down to feed them.

verses.kjv: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
verses.modern: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be His king, because they refused to return.

verses.kjv: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
verses.modern: A sword will flash in their cities; it will devour their false prophets and put an end to their plans.

verses.kjv: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
verses.modern: My people are bent to backsliding from Me. Though they call to the Most High, none at all would exalt Him.

verses.kjv: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
verses.modern: How can I give You up, Ephraim? How can I hand You over, Israel? How can I treat You like Admah? How can I make You like Zeboiim? My heart is changed within Me; all My compassion is aroused.

verses.kjv: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
verses.modern: I will not carry out My fierce anger; I will not destroy Ephraim again. For I am God, and not a man — the Holy One among You. I will not come against their cities.

verses.kjv: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
verses.modern: They will follow the LORD; He will roar like a lion. When He roars, His children will come trembling from the west.

verses.kjv: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt, like doves from Assyria. I will settle them in their homes, declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
verses.modern: Ephraim has surrounded Me with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit. But Judah yet rules with God and is faithful with the saints.

chapters.summary: The LORD remembers how He loved Israel as a child and called His son out of Egypt. But the more He called them, the further they went from Him. He taught Ephraim to walk, took them by the arms, drew them with cords of love — yet they refused to return. "How shall I give you up, Ephraim?" His compassion is stirred; He will not execute the fierceness of His anger.

verses.kjv: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.modern: Ephraim feeds on the wind; He pursues the east wind all day and multiplies lies and violence. He makes a treaty with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
verses.modern: The LORD has a charge to bring against Judah; He will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to His deeds.

verses.kjv: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
verses.modern: In the womb He grasped His brother's heel; as a man he struggled with God.

verses.kjv: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Beth-el, and there he spake with us;
verses.modern: He struggled with the angel and overcame him; he wept and begged for His favor. He met God at Bethel, and there God spoke with Him —

verses.kjv: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.
verses.modern: the LORD God Almighty, the LORD is His name of renown!

verses.kjv: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
verses.modern: But You must return to Your God; maintain love and justice, and wait for Your God always.

verses.kjv: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
verses.modern: The merchant uses dishonest scales and loves to defraud.

verses.kjv: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
verses.modern: Ephraim boasts, "I am very rich; I have become wealthy. With all my wealth they will not find in me any iniquity or sin."

verses.kjv: And I that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.modern: I am the LORD Your God, Who brought You out of Egypt. I will yet make You to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.

verses.kjv: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
verses.modern: I spoke to the prophets, gave them many visions, and told parables through them.

verses.kjv: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
verses.modern: Is Gilead wicked? Its people are worthless! Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Their altars will be like piles of stones on a plowed field.

verses.kjv: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
verses.modern: Jacob fled to the country of Aram; Israel served to get a wife, and to pay for her he tended sheep.

verses.kjv: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.modern: The LORD used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt, by a prophet He cared for Him.

verses.kjv: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
verses.modern: But Ephraim has aroused His bitter anger; His Lord will leave on Him the guilt of His bloodshed and will repay Him for His contempt.

chapters.summary: Ephraim feeds on wind and pursues the east wind — making treaties with Assyria and sending oil to Egypt. The LORD has a controversy with Judah as well. Jacob wrestled with the angel and prevailed; the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt by a prophet, and by a prophet He preserved them. Ephraim has provoked the LORD bitterly, and his blood will be left on him.

verses.kjv: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
verses.modern: When Ephraim spoke, men trembled; He was exalted in Israel. But He became guilty of Baal worship and died.

verses.kjv: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
verses.modern: Now they sin more and more; they make cast idols from their silver, cleverly fashioned images — all of them the work of craftsmen. It is said of these people, "They offer human sacrifices and kiss the calf-idols."

verses.kjv: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.modern: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears, like chaff swirling from a threshing floor, like smoke escaping through a window.

verses.kjv: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
verses.modern: But I am the LORD Your God, Who brought You out of Egypt. You shall acknowledge no God but Me, no Savior except Me.

verses.kjv: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.modern: I cared for You in the desert, in the land of burning heat.

verses.kjv: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
verses.modern: When I fed them, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, they became proud; then they forgot Me.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
verses.modern: So I will be like a lion to them, like a leopard I will lurk by the path.

verses.kjv: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
verses.modern: Like a bear robbed of her cubs, I will attack them and rip them open; like a lion I will devour them — a wild animal will tear them apart.

verses.kjv: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
verses.modern: You are destroyed, O Israel, because you are against Me, against your helper.

verses.kjv: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
verses.modern: Where is Your king, that He may save You? Where are Your rulers in all Your towns, of whom You said, "Give me a king and princes"?

verses.kjv: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
verses.modern: So in My anger I gave You a king, and in My wrath I took Him away.

verses.kjv: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
verses.modern: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up; His sins are kept on record.

verses.kjv: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
verses.modern: Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him, but he is a child without wisdom; when the time arrives, He does not come to the opening of the womb.

verses.kjv: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
verses.modern: I will deliver this people from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. O death, I will be Your plagues; O grave, I will be Your destruction. I will have no compassion.

verses.kjv: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
verses.modern: Even though He thrives among His brothers, an east wind from the LORD will come, blowing in from the desert. His spring will fail and His well dry up. His storehouse will be plundered of all its treasures.

verses.kjv: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.modern: The people of Samaria must bear their guilt, because they have rebelled against their God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to the ground, their pregnant women ripped open.

chapters.summary: When Ephraim spoke, men trembled — but he sinned through Baal and died. They continue to sin, making molten images. Therefore the LORD will be to them like a lion, like a leopard, like a bear robbed of her cubs. "O Israel, you have destroyed yourself, but in Me is your help." The LORD will ransom them from the power of the grave and redeem them from death.

verses.kjv: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
verses.modern: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God. Your sins have been your downfall!

verses.kjv: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
verses.modern: Take words with You and return to the LORD. Say to Him: "Forgive all our iniquity and receive us graciously, that we may offer the fruit of our lips.

verses.kjv: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
verses.modern: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount warhorses. We will never again say 'Our gods' to what our own hands have made, for in You the fatherless find mercy."

verses.kjv: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.modern: "I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely, for My anger has turned away from Him.

verses.kjv: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.modern: I will be like the dew to Israel; He will blossom like a lily. Like a cedar of Lebanon He will send down His roots;

verses.kjv: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.modern: his young shoots will grow. His splendor will be like an olive tree, His fragrance like a cedar of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.modern: People will again live in His shade. They will flourish like the grain; they will blossom like the vine, and His fame will be like the wine from Lebanon.

verses.kjv: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
verses.modern: Ephraim will say, 'What more have I to do with idols?' I will answer Him and care for Him. I am like a green pine tree; Your fruitfulness comes from Me."

verses.kjv: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.modern: Who is wise? Let Him understand these things. Who is discerning? Let Him know them. The ways of the LORD are right; the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.

chapters.summary: The LORD calls Israel to return and bring words of repentance: "Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously." Assyria will not save them, and they will no longer call their idols their gods. The LORD will heal their backsliding and love them freely — Israel will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
